joe-builds-things.title: I Said Staging
joe-builds-things.line: Joe asks his AI to push to staging. Just staging.
joe-builds-things.coverAlt: Ep 1 cover: voxel Joe on the phone over the caption I told my AI to push to staging

joe-builds-things.title: Rotate Every Key
joe-builds-things.line: His host got breached, so the AI rotates every key. Every single one.
joe-builds-things.coverAlt: Ep 2 cover: voxel Joe from the front with both hands on his head, over the caption my host got breached, 15 API keys

joe-builds-things.title: Let Me Fix That
joe-builds-things.line: He asks the AI to fix one bug. It fixes everything, including the app.
joe-builds-things.coverAlt: Ep 3 cover: a worried voxel Joe over the caption I asked AI to fix one bug

joe-builds-things.title: Order For Me
joe-builds-things.line: He asks the AI to order one iced americano. It adds a few touches.
joe-builds-things.coverAlt: Ep 4 cover: a shocked voxel Joe in a coffee shop over the caption I let AI order my coffee, $38.50 for this
